rows.title: Cataract Surgery
rows.summary: Careful assessment of your vision and a clear discussion of your treatment options.
rows.alt: An operation theatre with an operating table, operating microscope, surgical console and a clock panel on the wall

rows.title: Glaucoma Management
rows.summary: Assessment and regular follow-up, because glaucoma needs long-term monitoring.
rows.alt: A staff member and a patient at a pre-examination eye-testing instrument

rows.title: Comprehensive Eye Examinations
rows.summary: Routine check-ups and examinations for specific eye concerns, explained in plain language.
rows.alt: Dr. Poonam Jain examining a patient at a slit-lamp unit; the patient is seen from behind

rows.title: Eyelid Surgery (Blepharoplasty)
rows.summary: Assessment of heavy or drooping eyelids, for both functional and cosmetic reasons.

rows.title: Aesthetic Oculoplasty
rows.summary: Considered care for heavy eyelids, under-eye bags and age-related changes around the eyes.

rows.title: Reconstructive Oculoplasty
rows.summary: Treatment for drooping eyelids (ptosis), eyelid malposition and tear-drainage problems.
